25: function Stop-OpenVikingIfRunning {
26:   $p = Get-Process -Name "openviking-server" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
27:   if (-not $p) { return $false }
28:   Write-Log "Stopping openviking-server (pid $($p.Id)) for vectordb snapshot"
29:   Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force

33: 
34: function Start-OpenVikingIfDown {
35:   $listening = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":1933 " | Select-String "LISTENING"

37:   if (-not (Test-Path $OvServer)) {
38:     Write-Log "WARN: OV server exe missing, skip start"
39:     return
40:   }
41:   Write-Log "Starting openviking-server"
42:   Start-Process -FilePath $OvServer -ArgumentList "--config", $OvConf -WindowStyle Minimized
43:   Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
44: }
45: 
46: # PS 5.1 turns native stderr piped via 2>&1 into ErrorRecord and aborts under Stop.
47: # Redirect all streams to a file (no pipeline), then log the lines and check exit code.
48: function Invoke-Snapshot([string]$scriptPath, [string]$tag, [string[]]$argv) {
49:   $tmp = Join-Path $LogDir "$tag.out"
50:   Write-Log "RUN: $scriptPath $($argv -join ' ')"
51:   & $Node $scriptPath @argv *> $tmp
52:   $code = $LASTEXITCODE
53:   if (Test-Path $tmp) {
54:     foreach ($l in (Get-Content $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Log ([string]$l) }
55:     Remove-Item $tmp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
56:   }
57:   Write-Log "EXIT: $code"
58:   return $code
59: }

62: if ($Push) { $commitArgs += "--push" }
63:

70:   Write-Log "=== snapshot-openviking-memory.mjs ==="
71:   $c2 = Invoke-Snapshot $MemScript "memory" $commitArgs
72:   if ($c2 -ne 0) { throw "snapshot-openviking-memory failed exit $c2" }
73: 
74:   Write-Log "DONE"
75: } catch {
76:   Write-Log "FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
77:   throw
78: } finally {
79:   if ($wasRunning) { Start-OpenVikingIfDown }
